title: Move the calibration and control-scheme saves to the checked save format (damaged files crash the engine's loader)
acceptance: Both slots load through UETMSaveStore's checked reader (header, CRC, backup)
A damaged ETM_Calibration or ETM_Input file gives defaults, not a crash
description: Found in T-0023: the engine asserts inside LoadGameFromSlot on some damaged save files. ETM_Calibration (T-0007) and ETM_Input (T-0012) still load that way, so a power cut while either is written could crash every later launch.
